in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהושוע הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא הישועה' או 'אלוהים מושיע'. השם נגזר משתי מילים: 'יהו' (אלוהים) ו'ישוע' (ישועה). השם יהושוע היה שמו של נביא ומנהיג צבאי חשוב בתנ'ך, שובח במקרא כמי שהוביל את בני ישראל לכיבוש הארץ המובטחת.

in_greek.name: Ἰησουᾶς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰησουᾶς (Ἰησοῦς) παρ' Ἑβραίων ὁ Θεός ἡ σωτηρία ἐστίν. Τὸ ὄνομα παρ' Ἑβραίων σημαίνει 'Θεός σωτήρ' ἤ 'Θεὸς ὁ救ῶν'. Ἰησουᾶς ἦν ὁ προφήτης καὶ στρατηγὸς ὁδηγὸς τοῦ λαοῦ Ισραήλ εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας.

in_latin.name: Ioshuah
in_latin.long_meaning: Ioshuah nomen hebraicum est quod significat 'Deus salus' vel 'Deus salvator'. Nomen Ioshuah derivatum est ex duobus verbis hebraicis: 'Iehovah' (Deus) et 'ieshua' (salus). Ioshuah fuit propheta et dux militaris qui populum Israeliticum in terram promissionis duxit.

in_english.name: Joshuah
in_english.meaning: God is salvation or God saves
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joshuah is derived from the Hebrew name 'Yehoshua', which means 'God is salvation' or 'God saves'. It is composed of two Hebrew words: 'Yah' (God) and 'shua' (salvation). In the Bible, Joshua was a prominent figure, the successor of Moses, who led the Israelites into the Promised Land. The name Joshuah symbolizes divine salvation and protection, reflecting God's power to save and deliver His people. Throughout Christian tradition, the name Joshuah has been associated with courage, leadership, and faith.

biblical_reference.note: The book of Joshua narrates the conquest of Canaan under Joshua's leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Joshua holds a significant cultural impact in both the Jewish and Christian traditions. In the Jewish tradition, Joshua is revered as a great military and religious leader. He played a pivotal role in leading the Israelites across the Jordan River and into the Promised Land after the Exodus from Egypt. In the Christian tradition, Joshua is recognized as a type of Christ, as he led the Israelites on a spiritual journey towards the fulfillment of God's promise.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Joshua carries deep spiritual significance as it serves as a reminder of God's faithfulness and salvation. It is a name that inspires hope and trust in God's promises. Joshua exemplifies the belief that God is always present and guiding us through life's challenges, just as he led the Israelites to the Promised Land. The name Joshua also signifies strength and courage, as it was given to the leader who led God's people to the fulfillment of their most profound dreams and desires.
